description: This file defines the IProviderRuntime interface in the Orleans framework, providing methods and properties for provider callbacks, including access to grain factory, service provider, and extension binding functionality.

classes.name: IProviderRuntime
classes.description: Interface for provider callbacks into the provider-manager, enabling access to runtime functionalities such as grain factory, service provider, and extension binding.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds an extension to an addressable object, returning the extension and its interface reference.
